Class PlacingState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.model.state.PlacingState
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameStateLogic
public class PlacingState extends Object implements GameStateLogic
Represents the phase where players place their totems on the offer track.

During this state, the game waits for players to take turns placing their totems on available OfferTiles. The state remains active until all totems for the current round have been placed. Once placement is complete, it transitions to the ResolvingState.

    • execute

      public void execute(Game g)
      Description copied from interface: GameStateLogic
      Executes the main logic associated with the current state.

      This method is invoked by the Game class to delegate the execution of the current phase's rules. Inside this method, the concrete state can modify the game data and, if the end-of-phase conditions are met, call g.changeState(...) to advance the game.

      Specified by:
      execute in interface GameStateLogic
      Parameters:
      g - The main game instance the state must operate on. It provides access to the boards, players, and decks. Must not be null.

    • forceSkipCurrentPlayer

      public void forceSkipCurrentPlayer(Game game)
      Force-skips the turn of the currently active player, used when that player has disconnected.

      The skipped player never placed a totem on an offer tile during this round, so unlike the normal return-from-tile flow in ResolvingState, no food bonus or penalty applies here — the player is re-inserted into the track via TurnOrderTrack.placeWithoutEffects(int, Player) rather than TurnOrderTrack.setPlayerAt(int, Player). This keeps them eligible to act again starting from the next round's PlacingState, instead of vanishing from the turn rotation entirely.

      If this was the last player still expected to place a totem, the state transitions to ResolvingState exactly as it would after a normal placement.

      Specified by:
      forceSkipCurrentPlayer in interface GameStateLogic
      Parameters:
      game - the current game context
